fields.title: Ethiopia eGP procurement record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Record shape depends on 'mode': 'latest'/'list' rows come from the eGP portal's Publication Plan Lots register (list-level fields plus the full raw upstream object); 'detail' rows are item-level detail (quantities, price, specs, milestones) for one lot. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: 'latest' / 'list' for those modes, or the exact lot ID requested in 'detail' mode.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-cms-publication-lots-api, S1-cms-publication-lot-detail-api, or 'none' on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed/degraded records: http_<code>, unexpected_shape, blocked_or_transient, or invalid_input.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

id.title: Lot ID
id.description: (latest/list mode) The portal's internal ID for this procurement lot -- pass this into 'detail' mode's lotIds for full item-level data.

title.title: Title
title.description: (latest/list mode) English lot name, falling back to its description if no name is set.

description.title: Description
description.description: (latest/list mode) Bilingual {am, en} description object, as returned by the portal.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: (latest/list mode) English name of the procuring federal agency/institution.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal year
fiscalYear.description: (latest/list mode) Ethiopian fiscal year label, e.g. 'ET-FY-2019' (runs July 8 - July 7 on the Gregorian calendar).

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: (latest/list mode) The procuring entity's own tender/bid reference number, e.g. 'MOR-NCB -G-0012-2019/Bid'.

timestamp.title: Last updated
timestamp.description: (latest/list mode) Upstream last-modified timestamp for this lot -- the field this actor sorts 'latest' mode by.

organizationName.title: Organization (raw)
organizationName.description: (latest/list mode) Bilingual {am, en} organization name object, as returned by the portal.

publicationPlan.title: Parent plan
publicationPlan.description: (latest/list mode) Full raw object for the annual procurement plan this lot belongs to (plan name, organization, fiscal year, status, dates).

items.title: Line items
items.description: (detail mode) Every item in this lot -- name/description, commodity classification, quantity, estimated unit price and currency, technical specifications.

milestones.title: Delivery milestones
milestones.description: (detail mode) Scheduled milestones for this lot (type, lead time, due date).
